explanation: L0/N1274+ is a context-free token-type detector at layer 0: its strength is a fixed function of the single token at the current position (unchanged by preceding text, all input attribution on that token, peaks always on that token), and its trigger is the letter c at the END of a token - final-letter minimal pairs separate cleanly ('ac' 1.37, 'ec' 1.63, 'ic' 1.30, 'oc' 1.15, 'roc' 1.51, 'Sac' 1.29 versus 'at'/'et'/'it'/'ot'/'rot'/'sat' 0.00-0.18), with a weaker response to final b or p ('ob' 0.80, 'op' 0.50, 'ub' 0.44) and to the bare capital 'C' (0.73-0.92, the only one of the 52 single-character tokens that fires; every other single letter is exactly 0.000). Predict active when a probe's tokens include a c-final piece - typically a word the tokenizer splits at its c ('ec' in 'lifecycles', 'ac' in 'hyperacidity', 'ic' in 'cystic', 'OC' in 'OCaml', 'ec' in 'Fecundity') - and predict inactive for function words, punctuation, whitespace, digits, ordinary words ('the', 'and', 'was', 'Paris', 'clear') and whole c-final words such as 'magic', 'logic', 'specific', 'economic' and 'music' (all 0.00); the honest leftovers that also fire are a minority of c-free technical/Latinate stems ('process' 1.11, 'call' 1.07, 'times' 1.12, 'transfer' 0.65, 'term' 0.77, 'primary' 0.45) and a few c-final technical words ('cystic' 1.43, 'domestic' 0.64, 'systematic' 0.43), so c-free technical vocabulary is the uncertain region rather than a predicted-inactive one.
